Agent keys of a person, service accounts and their API keys, and the SCIM tokens for directory sync.

## me

### `GET /api/items/{short_code}/watch`

The watch of the caller on the item.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | The item |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`WatchState`](../schemas/#watchstate) | Whether the caller watches the item, and with its children |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller is a service account |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No item has the short code |

### `PUT /api/items/{short_code}/watch`

Watch the item. A coarse change of the item makes a `watch`
notification for the caller: moved, edited, note added, done. A change
that the caller made makes none. With `with_children: true`, a change of
a child of the item makes one too. A second `PUT` changes
`with_children`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | The item |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`WatchRequest`](../schemas/#watchrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`WatchState`](../schemas/#watchstate) | The watch after the change |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller is a service account |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No item has the short code, the code is retired, or the item is archived |

### `DELETE /api/items/{short_code}/watch`

Stop the watch of the caller on the item. No watch: nothing changes,
and the answer is the same.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | The item |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`WatchState`](../schemas/#watchstate) | The caller does not watch the item now |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller is a service account |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No item has the short code |

### `GET /api/me/agent-keys`

The caller's agent keys (metadata only, never a secret), newest first.

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ApiKeyListResponse`](../schemas/#apikeylistresponse) | Key metadata (never secrets) |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller is a service account |

### `POST /api/me/agent-keys`

Make an agent key for the caller: return the secret ONCE, keep only its
hash. Kairos refuses a service account, and a request made with an agent key.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateApiKeyRequest`](../schemas/#createapikeyrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`ApiKeyCreatedResponse`](../schemas/#apikeycreatedresponse) | Key made; the secret is shown once |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller is a service account, or the request uses an agent key |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Empty name, bad expiry, expires_at with no_expiry, or an unknown capability or board in the scope |

### `DELETE /api/me/agent-keys/{key_id}`

Revoke one of the caller's agent keys (soft: `revoked_at` set). The key of
another person, or an unknown id → 404; already revoked → 409.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key_id` | path | yes | `string` | Agent key id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeletedResponse`](../schemas/#deletedresponse) | Key revoked |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller is a service account |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller has no key with this id |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Already revoked |

### `POST /api/me/agent-keys/{key_id}/rotate`

Rotate one of the caller's agent keys (KAIROS-T-0370). A new key with a
new secret takes the place of the key. Kairos shows the secret once. The
old secret works for the grace time (`KAIROS_API_KEY_ROTATION_GRACE_SECS`,
1 day by default), then it ends. A request made with an agent key cannot rotate a
key. No body.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key_id` | path | yes | `string` | Agent key id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`ApiKeyRotatedResponse`](../schemas/#apikeyrotatedresponse) | The new key; the secret is shown once |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller is a service account, or the request uses an agent key |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller has no key with this id |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The key is revoked, expired, or rotated already |

### `GET /api/me/notification-settings`

The caller's notification settings: each kind, and whether it is on.

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`NotificationSettings`](../schemas/#notificationsettings) | Each kind, and whether it is on |

### `PUT /api/me/notification-settings`

Turn kinds of notification on or off for the caller. A kind that is not
in the body does not change. Kairos refuses a body with no kind.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateNotificationSettingsRequest`](../schemas/#updatenotificationsettingsrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`NotificationSettings`](../schemas/#notificationsettings) | The settings after the change |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller is a service account |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The body names no kind |

### `GET /api/me/notifications`

The caller's notifications: each unread one (newest first, 100 at most),
then the 20 newest read ones. `before` gives the next page of unread
ones. `read_before` gives the next page of read ones: 100 at most, read
before that one (KAIROS-T-0584). The read state is the caller's: the person, or the agent key of
the request (KAIROS-T-0550). A service account has none.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `before` | query | no | `string` | The id of a notification. The page has the unread notifications older than it, and no read ones |
| `read_before` | query | no | `string` | The id of a read notification. The page has the read notifications that the caller read before it, 100 at most, and no unread ones |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`NotificationList`](../schemas/#notificationlist) | The unread notifications, then the newest read ones |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | `before` or `read_before` is not a notification of the caller |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | `before` and `read_before` together, or `read_before` is unread for the caller |

### `POST /api/me/notifications/read`

Mark notifications of the caller read: `ids`, or `all: true` with
`up_to`. The read is the caller's: the person, or the agent key of the
request (KAIROS-T-0550). An id that is not a notification of the caller
is a 404 that names it, and nothing changes. An id that is read already
does not change.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`MarkNotificationsReadRequest`](../schemas/#marknotificationsreadrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`MarkNotificationsReadResponse`](../schemas/#marknotificationsreadresponse) | The ids that changed, and the unread count after |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | An id is not a notification of the caller |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Neither ids nor all, or both, or all without up_to |

### `GET /api/me/watches`

Each watch of the caller, by code. An agent key gives the watches of
its person.

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`WatchList`](../schemas/#watchlist) | Each watch of the caller, by code |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller is a service account |

### `GET /api/me/work`

The work of the caller, in two lanes.

- Initiatives: the strategies and the initiatives that the caller owns.
- Tasks: the claims of the caller and of the agent keys of the caller.
  The Todo, Active and Blocked tasks under an initiative of the caller.
  The tasks that one of these tasks blocks.

Each item has a state (`todo`, `active`, `blocked`) and its open
blockers. The answer has no item in a done column.

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`MyWork`](../schemas/#mywork) | The two lanes of the work of the caller |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not a member of the organization |

## service-accounts

### `GET /api/org/agent-keys`

The agent keys of the persons of the organization, newest first (never
a secret). Org-admin-only.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user` | query | no | `string` | Only the keys of this person: a user id (UUID) or an email. |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_OrgAgentKey`](../schemas/#listenvelope_orgagentkey) | A page of the agent keys, with the owner of each |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The organization admin role is required |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The user filter names no person |

### `DELETE /api/org/agent-keys/{key_id}`

Revoke the agent key of any person (soft: `revoked_at` set). Writes an
activity row and tells the owner. Org-admin-only. An unknown id, or the
id of a service-account key → 404; already revoked → 409.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key_id` | path | yes | `string` | Agent key id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeletedResponse`](../schemas/#deletedresponse) | Key revoked |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The organization admin role is required |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No agent key has this id |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Already revoked |

List a service account's keys (metadata only). Org-admin-only.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Service account id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|

### `POST /api/service-accounts/{id}/keys`

Mint an API key for a service account: return the secret ONCE, store only
its hash. Org-admin-only. Unknown service account → 404.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Service account id (UUID) |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateApiKeyRequest`](../schemas/#createapikeyrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`ApiKeyCreatedResponse`](../schemas/#apikeycreatedresponse) | Key minted; secret shown once |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown service account |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Empty name, bad expiry, expires_at with no_expiry, or a scope (the key of a service account has none) |

### `DELETE /api/service-accounts/{id}/keys/{key_id}`

Revoke a key (soft: `revoked_at` set). Org-admin-only. Unknown ids → 404;
already revoked → 409.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Service account id (UUID) |
| `key_id` | path | yes | `string` | API key id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeletedResponse`](../schemas/#deletedresponse) | Key revoked |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown service account or key |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Already revoked |

### `POST /api/service-accounts/{id}/keys/{key_id}/rotate`

Rotate a key of a service account (KAIROS-T-0370). A new key with a new
secret takes the place of the key. Kairos shows the secret once. The old
secret works for the grace time (`KAIROS_API_KEY_ROTATION_GRACE_SECS`, 1
day by default), then it ends. Org-admin-only. No body.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Service account id (UUID) |
| `key_id` | path | yes | `string` | API key id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`ApiKeyRotatedResponse`](../schemas/#apikeyrotatedresponse) | The new key; the secret is shown once |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown service account or key |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The key is revoked, expired, or rotated already |

## scim-tokens

### `GET /api/scim-tokens`

List the tenant's SCIM tokens (metadata only). Org-admin-only.

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ScimTokenListResponse`](../schemas/#scimtokenlistresponse) | Token metadata (never secrets) |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |

### `POST /api/scim-tokens`

Create a SCIM token: mint the secret, store only its hash, return the
secret ONCE. Org-admin-only.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateScimTokenRequest`](../schemas/#createscimtokenrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`ScimTokenCreatedResponse`](../schemas/#scimtokencreatedresponse) | Token created; secret shown once |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Empty name |

### `DELETE /api/scim-tokens/{id}`

Revoke a SCIM token (soft: `revoked_at` set, row retained for audit).
Unknown id → 404; already revoked → 409. Org-admin-only.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | SCIM token id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ScimTokenRevokedResponse`](../schemas/#scimtokenrevokedresponse) | Token revoked |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown token id |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Already revoked |
